supersedes.priorDungeonGearRule: The previous Shiverlake Bellwake V3 dungeon gear was proposed as nontradeable/account bound; user now requires authentic boss-only drops to be player-tradable, including resale. V4 explicitly replaces old nontradeable restriction.
supersedes.earlierGeneralEarnedOnlyRule: The previous PR #1460 rule blocking all earned equipment from the Player Market is superseded for authentic new-generation dungeon boss gear; restriction remains for shops/crafting/Mark exchange and non-boss sources.
supersedes.retains: The 2.0-only player-market generation and original boss-mint custody provenance protection in hidden PR #1651; no client tags can authorize trade.

sourceRefs: PR #1184 actual surviving dungeons/bosses and unpublished statuses
PR #1438 future Endurance boss terminal eligibility and reward charge integrity
PR #1651 EQ2-only Player Market legacy fence
PR #1686 prior Shiverlake Bellwake and T5 sets
assumptions: Dungeon source policy from hidden source, no actual database change, no verified drop rate; Ashlands future region progression and T7 level gate remain provisional

nonBossAcquisitionRoutesForbidden: player-to-player creation without original boss receipt
universalRules.noForcedSpecificClassDrop: Boss rewards may drop class-gear from any class so pieces can be sold to other classes; alternative future role-biased weighting requires fairness review.
universalRules.rarityAndQuality: same existing 2.0 approved rarity+quality roll model; dungeon-source exclusivity is separate from rarity and innate authored percent
universalRules.percentInnates: every new dungeon item has one deterministic percent or percentage-point channel, rounded per tier; legal random affixes stack but must fit the approved source/rarity/quality/power budget and not duplicate-scale innates
universalRules.itemSourceMintAndMarket: Immutable signed physical item instance ID, boss-terminal source receipt, original owner, dungeon/boss ID, versioned EQ2 mint, rolled stats, custody chain; second-sale must verify original source and current owner every time
universalRules.onlyGenuineBossVictory: Failed/incomplete dungeon, normal/elite rooms, boss preview, full Marks, Boon, seasonal FX, temporary artifacts, social Echo donors and reward retries never issue permanent dungeon gear
universalRules.p2wSafeguards: No merchant, paid shortcut or Marks gear exchange. Market is strictly peer to peer from genuine drops; limit excessive free percent stacking and check rarity roll/market concentration.
universalRules.futureImplementation: Loot generation and listing/purchase server modules must actively enforce this; catalogue flags alone are not authority.
universalRules.dungeonExclusiveArt: Approved Style 4 system direction, every new item visual requires approval before app UI/theme implementation

dungeons.bossVariantPolicy: one server-frozen 50/50 outcome per run; both named pools valid, not two bosses per run
dungeons.bossDropRarity: candidate any premium boss equipment per eligible victory 3%-5% total before per-boss weighted item choice; NOT approved or measured; per named item should be very rare

bossLootProbabilityCandidate.perItemProbability: Do not equate 3%-5% with named item rate. Given ~12-15 candidates per boss and 50/50 boss assignment, illustrative individual drop chance ~0.10%-0.21% per otherwise eligible run, BEFORE actual eligibility and weights.
